exposure: Perinatal activity scores (based on 3 key obstetric and 4 neonatal interventions)
outcome: Survival without major neonatal morbidities (MNM): intraventricular haemorrhage grade 3-4, cystic periventricular leucomalacia, surgical necrotising enterocolitis, retinopathy of prematurity stage 3-5, severe bronchopulmonary dysplasia
cohort: The study included 977 infants (567 live births and 410 stillbirths) born at 22 and 23 weeks' gestational age in Sweden between 2004-2007, 2014-2016, and 2017-2019.
finding: Increased perinatal activity was associated with reduced mortality and increased chances of survival without major neonatal morbidities in infants born at 22 and 23 weeks of gestational age.
